source_placement.mirror_law: horizontal surface: elevation preserved, azimuth +180 — the M5 closed-lid law in the characterization script's spherical convention

jitter_distribution.shader_law: (voronoi_colour - 0.5) * jitter_deg/90 added to the normal; per-axis uniform

source_solid_angle.uncertainty: ±30% on the cell census (region shape, edge cells, lobe-width approximation)

energy_calibration.law: E_{n+1} = E_n * (target - base_peak) / peak_n iterated to the fixed predeclared target

EVENT_LUMINANCE_DOMINANCE.why: derived from the same bright mask as the count

measured_in: resolved pixel events, never particle metadata

candidate_factors: the aligned-fraction integral treated the source as a point set at its half-angle; finite-area integration over a 140mm panel admits facets aligned anywhere within the full angular support, roughly doubling acceptance at the margins
the per-axis-uniform tilt model ignores the dz component of the shader jitter, which widens the acceptance disc for facets tilted toward the camera
one Voronoi cell can present multiple bright pixels split by the 4-connected labeller into more than one event when partially occluded by neighbouring cell edges
the planar cell census used a square-cell approximation; Chebychev Voronoi cells vary in visible area, biasing the count of resolvable particles upward
prediction_model.not_done: the model was NOT refit to 87 and is NOT called validated; the census classifier itself was visually verified against the annotated event map, which is the blocking question, and it is sound

SHIMMER_negative_contrast_SUPERSEDED.what_it_over_reached: SHIMMER flakes are 0.786px — below the rig's own 3px validity floor. Its zero cannot distinguish "continuous, therefore no discrete events" from "too small to resolve, therefore no discrete events". The same zero was ALSO cited as proof flakes are unresolvable at this resolution; both readings cannot be load-bearing at once.
SHIMMER_negative_contrast_SUPERSEDED.weaker_claim_that_stands: SHIMMER produces no resolvable discrete events at this resolution — true, and all the census establishes about shimmer
SHIMMER_negative_contrast_SUPERSEDED.unaffected: the GLITTER census PASS itself: 0.70mm = 10px, comfortably resolvable, 113 scene-linear events with a live map; and POWDER_MATTE's zero, which declares no particles at all
SHIMMER_negative_contrast_SUPERSEDED.consequence: SHIMMER-vs-GLITTER discreteness discrimination now rests on GLITTER's positive discreteness plus the reflective rig's measured SHIMMER-vs-METALLIC separation; the shimmer-continuity CLAIM is carried by the flake rig (coherence/correlation axes), not by the census zero
